rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: This MCP server provides direct integration with Cisco APIC (Application Policy Infrastructure Controller) for managing Application Centric Infrastructure fabrics through REST API operations. Built using Python with FastMCP, httpx, and a singleton authentication manager, it offers tools for fetching managed objects by class name and creating automated configuration backups to SCP servers with AES encryption. The implementation handles APIC session token management with automatic renewal, SSL certificate bypassing for lab environments, and includes comprehensive error handling for network operations, making it valuable for network automation workflows, infrastructure monitoring, and automated backup operations where AI assistants need to interact with Cisco ACI fabrics programmatically.
